Name: (CP) Danganronpa Plushies (Monomi and Monokuma)
Author: hamsssta
Description:
As I was playing with taconeko99's Futan Bear and Plush Bunny Retexture - Monokuma and Monomi original XNB mod and Donirexian's Content Patcher for taconeko99's Futan Bear and Plush Bunny Retexture - Monokuma and Monomi (Danganronpa), I've noticed absent textures from 1.6 update and began to investigate what mod causes this problem. After finding out it's one of my favourite mods with danganronpa plushies, I just couldn't BEAR to delete it and continue playing without it, so I decided to fix it! 

This mod is compatible with [b]version 1.6[/b] of the game and respective versions of [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]Content Patcher[/b]. The only thing it does is replacing 2 textures: Plush Bunny (Craftables) - Monomi and Lg. Futan Bear (Furniture) - Monokuma. I intended it to be easily transferable to newer versions of the game so I hope you won't have the same problem as I did.

If you want to disable both or one of them, you can:

[list]
[*]Change settings in [b]content.json[/b].
[/list][list=1]
[*]Open [b]content.json[/b] in mod folder [b][CP] DanganPlushies[/b].
[*]In "[b]ConfigSchema[/b]" find Plush Bunny (Monomi) or Lg. Futan Bear (Monokuma) and change its "[b]Default[/b]" value to [font=Courier New]disabled[/font].


[/list][list]
[*]Use mod [b]GenericModConfigMenu[/b].
[/list][list=1]
[*]Go to [b]GenericModConfigMenu[/b]'s setting menu in the game.
[*]Go to [b](CP) DanganPlushies[/b].
[*]Change Plush Bunny's (Monomi) or Lg. Futan Bear's (Monokuma) value to [font=Courier New]disabled[/font]. 
[/list]
Have fun! ❀

[u]Important warning from my girlfriend:[/u] this mod works on its own, you first need to delete taconeko99's Futan Bear and Plush Bunny Retexture - Monokuma and Monomi original XNB mod and Donirexian's Donirexian's Content Patcher for taconeko99's Futan Bear and Plush Bunny Retexture - Monokuma and Monomi (Danganronpa).
